label: Мы
description: First-person plural sentences focused on shared action, shared objects, and collective agreement.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Shared motion. 1. 'Мы' makes the sentence plural and collective. 2. 'Идем' changes to match the plural subject. 3. 'Домой' keeps the destination direct and useful.

Strategic focus: Group action. 1. 'Читаем' is the first-person plural present tense. 2. 'Книгу' stays as a clear direct object. 3. This sentence is a good foundation for seeing plural agreement in action.

Strategic focus: Plural subject with simple object. 1. 'Пишем' is the plural form of the verb. 2. 'Письмо' stays concrete and easy to visualize. 3. This sentence makes the plural person ending feel natural.
Strategic focus: Collective perception. 1. 'Видим' is the plural present form. 2. 'Стол' is a stable object target. 3. The sentence helps learners feel how the verb changes with the subject number.

Strategic focus: Shared evaluation. 1. 'Любим' is the correct plural present form. 2. 'Этот дом' ties the demonstrative to the masculine noun. 3. This is a natural sentence for practicing plural emotion and agreement.

Strategic focus: Common irregular verb. 1. 'Едим' is the plural form of 'есть'. 2. 'Хлеб' is a frequent, familiar object. 3. This sentence is especially useful because the plural form is different from both 'я ем' and 'ты ешь'.

Strategic focus: Shared survival need. 1. 'Пьем' is the first-person plural present tense. 2. 'Воду' shows the object form of a feminine noun. 3. This sentence is practical and useful in real-world conversation.
Strategic focus: Negation with group subject. 1. 'Не' negates the verb. 2. 'Понимаем' is the proper plural first-person form. 3. This is a key sentence for classroom or travel situations.
Strategic focus: Shared desire. 1. 'Хотим' is the plural first-person form. 2. 'Кофе' keeps the object everyday and familiar. 3. This sentence is very useful for polite, natural group speech.

Strategic focus: Group activity with location. 1. 'Работаем' is the plural present form. 2. 'Дома' remains a natural adverbial location. 3. The sentence shows how the verb changes while the location stays stable.

Strategic focus: Collective language identity. 1. 'Говорим' is the plural form. 2. 'По-русски' is the natural speech-mode adverb. 3. This sentence is very useful for learner identity and group practice.
Strategic focus: Group knowledge. 1. 'Знаем' shows the first-person plural form. 2. 'Это' is the referenced item. 3. This is a great sentence for reinforcing collective statement structure.

Strategic focus: Plural object handling. 1. 'Берем' is the plural form of the action verb. 2. 'Книгу' gives a simple direct object. 3. The sentence is useful because it sounds like real everyday speech.

Strategic focus: Shared physical action. 1. 'Открываем' is the plural present form. 2. 'Дверь' is a concrete and useful object. 3. This line helps learners feel the plural ending in a practical context.

Strategic focus: Plural perception. 1. 'Слышим' is the plural first-person form. 2. 'Музыку' remains a direct object. 3. This sentence is useful because it mirrors a very common real-world observation.

Strategic focus: Pronoun object form. 1. 'Видим' is plural first person. 2. 'Тебя' is the object form of 'ты'. 3. This sentence reinforces how pronouns change when they move away from subject position.

Strategic focus: Routine collective action. 1. 'Делаем' is a very common plural present form. 2. 'Чай' is a useful everyday noun. 3. This sentence is simple enough for rapid repetition while still being grammatical.

Strategic focus: Carrying as a group. 1. 'Несем' is the plural present form. 2. 'Сумку' is the object being carried. 3. This sentence is good for feeling how the verb morphology changes when the subject becomes plural.

Strategic focus: Group discovery. 1. 'Находим' is the plural form of 'находить'. 2. 'Ключ' keeps the object concrete. 3. This sentence is useful because it highlights the person-number contrast with singular forms.

Strategic focus: Collective thought plus case control. 1. 'Думаем' is the plural first-person form. 2. 'О работе' shows the prepositional case after 'о'. 3. This sentence is excellent for teaching that verbs shape the case of the nouns or nouns-like forms that follow.
